title: Molecular Recognition and Immunopharmacological Implications of Serratiopeptidase Targeting Snake Venom Bradykinin-Potentiating Peptides.
authors: Dhiman, Ankita; Singh, Rahul; Purohit, Rituraj
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold预测蛇毒BPP肽结构，结合HADDOCK对接、MD和Steered MD模拟研究其与舍雷肽酶的分子识别，属于蛋白质-肽相互作用的结构计算研究，方法常规但问题聚焦。
abstract: PURPOSE: Bradykinin-potentiating peptides (BPPs), found in snake venom, are known to modulate cardiovascular functions, but their susceptibility to enzymatic degradation remains poorly understood. METHODS: Models were generated using AlphaFold-Colab for five small BPPs (< 9 amino acids) that did not have experimentally solved structures, and those BPPs which had reliable predictions of structure (pLDDT > 80) were used for docking studies. Protein-peptide docking experiments were done using HADDOCK for studying the interaction between wild-type (WT) and mutant serratiopeptidase with BPPs. After selecting the best complex, simulation of the complex was done using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations for 100 ns and binding energy determination using MM/PBSA analysis. For checking the mechanical stability of the protein-peptide complexes, Steered MD was performed. RESULTS: HADDOCK docking identified BPP-4 as a favorable binder of WT and mutant serratiopeptidase supported by a HADDOCK score of -109.1 +/- 5.2 and minimal restraint violations. MD simulations revealed greater stability in the mutant complex supported by persistent hydrogen bonds, reduced RMSD/RMSF fluctuations, restricted conformational sampling in PCA, favorable MM/PBSA energy contributions, and a more stable conformational ensemble in cluster analysis. The Steered MD simulation showed a higher rupture force in the mutant BPP-4-serratiopeptidase complex compared to the WT. CONCLUSIONS: Computational analysis identified BPP-4 as a promising serratiopeptidase-binding peptide, with differences in binding affinity and mechanical stability between WT and mutant complexes. The results offer insight into BPP-serratiopeptidase recognition at the molecular level and set the basis for future experiments on peptide binding.
abstract_zh: 目的：蛇毒中发现的缓激肽增强肽（BPPs）已知可调节心血管功能，但其对酶降解的敏感性仍知之甚少。方法：使用AlphaFold-Colab为五个无实验解析结构的小型BPPs（< 9个氨基酸）生成模型，并将具有可靠结构预测（pLDDT > 80）的BPPs用于对接研究。使用HADDOCK进行蛋白质-肽对接实验，以研究野生型（WT）和突变型舍雷肽酶与BPPs之间的相互作用。选定最佳复合物后，使用分子动力学（MD）模拟进行100 ns的复合物模拟，并通过MM/PBSA分析确定结合能。为检查蛋白质-肽复合物的机械稳定性，进行了拉伸分子动力学（Steered MD）。结果：HADDOCK对接鉴定BPP-4为WT和突变型舍雷肽酶的有利结合物，其HADDOCK评分为-109.1 +/- 5.2，且约束违反最小。MD模拟显示突变型复合物具有更高的稳定性，表现为持续存在的氢键、降低的RMSD/RMSF波动、PCA中受限的构象采样、有利的MM/PBSA能量贡献，以及聚类分析中更稳定的构象集合。拉伸MD模拟显示，突变型BPP-4-舍雷肽酶复合物的断裂力高于WT。结论：计算分析鉴定BPP-4为有前景的舍雷肽酶结合肽，WT与突变型复合物在结合亲和力和机械稳定性上存在差异。结果提供了BPP-舍雷肽酶在分子水平上识别的见解，并为未来肽结合实验奠定了基础。
